description.text:
Sea Lanes has brought the UK’s award-winning open water swimming concept to Canary Wharf.

At the heart of Sea Lanes is a 50-metre, six-lane natural water swimming pool floating right in the dock, offering a unique swimming experience that bridges the gap between traditional pools and open water. After your swim, relax and recover in the eco-friendly saunas, powered entirely by renewable energy. The community clubhouse will be your year-round hub for wellness events, classes, and connecting with fellow swimmers, while the on-site food and beverage offering provides the perfect spot to refuel.
